description: Address semantic review findings: articles page error handling, password composable logout, login dead code removal, upload extension validation, and .gitignore coverage.
steps: Verify app/.gitignore already covers app/data/ (tokens.json and auth.json)
In articles.vue - wrap onMounted fetch with try/catch, add loadError ref, show error when config is null
In password.vue - replace raw $fetch logout with composable logout() function
In login.post.ts - remove dead guard for !auth.salt || !auth.hash
In upload.post.ts - add file extension validation
acceptance_criteria: articles.vue shows error message if API fetch fails on mount
password.vue uses composable logout() instead of raw $fetch + navigateTo
login.post.ts no longer has the dead code guard
upload.post.ts rejects files with invalid extensions
verification: Run npm run build from /projects/sandbox/WinterHome and confirm no TypeScript/build errors
